title: Exact commit
text: An item QA case selects one registered lane under the caller's matching item/task claim. Branch, checkout path and commit come from that same row, including a missing commit. Multiple lanes require an unambiguous selection; CI refuses explicit checkout, branch or SHA disagreement before publication. CI publishes an immutable commit, then stamps it through the existing snapshot authority only when the selected live checkout has the matching branch and clean exact HEAD. Missing or mismatched checkouts never supply a stamp. A stale durable head can be repaired with snapshot sync --head-only after verifying the already-published passing candidate, without rerunning its gate. Consumer product_ref inputs must name an exact pushed producer commit: QA verifies it on the producer remote before dispatch. An existing product_repo workflow input identifies that repository; otherwise one upstream cross-project companion project supplies its binding. Missing or ambiguous identity and unreadable or unpublished commits refuse with recovery. The consumer receives the gate-pushed commit after any producer rebase.
